LABELS vs QUESTIONNAIRE: ES3032 VARIABLE LABELS P901-P909 were compared with the P.9 rows of cues3032.pdf read from a 300-dpi render of scanned page 3 (not OCR), dot leaders dropped and wrapped lines joined: 8/9 agree character for character. The one difference is P907: the label reads 'Tener hijos/as o pensar tenerlos/las', the questionnaire row reads 'Tener hijos/as o pensar tenerlos'. item_text ships the QUESTIONNAIRE wording for p907 (what the interviewer read) and the labels verbatim for the other eight (checked in build.R). The mapping is unaffected: the label and the row sit at the same code and column (103). VALUE LABELS identical on all 9: 1 'Mucho' 2 'Bastante' 3 'Poco' 4 'Nada' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.', matching the questionnaire's column headers (Mucho / Bas-tante / Poco / Nada / NS / NC). No show card for P.9 (tarjetas3032.pdf has none for this question). P.9 is asked of all respondents ('A TODAS LAS PERSONAS ENTREVISTADAS', an interviewer routing header, not shipped). RESP BY DESIGN: the .do recodes 8 and 9 to missing, so live resp is {1,2,3,4}; 1 = Mucho (influences a lot). Dropped per item p901..p909: code 8 = 107/111/185/353/96/91/75/168/89; code 9 = 6/8/11/13/25/23/10/9/8. 33 respondents answered 8/9 on all nine, so live ids = 2431 of 2464.
